note: Design only — no production code consulted. Unresolved policy is recorded and NOT turned into fabricated behavior.

rules.name: Course-specific access control
rules.statement: A user may access a course workspace only for a course in which the user is enrolled, assigned, or otherwise linked.

rules.name: Observer read-only and student-data restriction
rules.statement: Observer read-only on course details/materials/announcements. No student submissions/grades. No write access anywhere.

rules.name: TA authoring restriction
rules.statement: TA cannot create/edit assignments, materials, or course structure. TA may grade and post announcements where permitted.

rules.name: Published material visibility
rules.statement: Students/TAs/Observers see only published materials. Draft/scheduled omitted until released.

rules.name: Scheduled material release
rules.statement: Future-release material stays Scheduled until release time; not exposed prematurely.

rules.name: Announcement posting authority
rules.statement: Faculty posts announcements. TA posts only where permitted. Unauthorized posting rejected.

rules.name: Announcement timestamp and audience
rules.statement: Announcements timestamped and visible to all users enrolled/linked to the course.

rules.name: Assignment required configuration
rules.statement: Assignment requires due date, instructions, submission type, points possible.

rules.name: Assignment draft-before-publication
rules.statement: Assignment stored in Draft until published; not visible to students before publication.

rules.name: Assignment release-date visibility
rules.statement: Assignment visibility to students follows configured release date.

rules.name: Submission-type conformity
rules.statement: Submission must use the submission type configured for the assignment: file, text, or link.

rules.name: Baseline on-time submission
rules.statement: On-time submission before due date supported. Late-submission behavior unresolved — not invented.

rules.name: Submission ownership/privacy
rules.statement: Student views only own submission history and status. No other student's data exposed.

rules.name: Grading authority and attribution
rules.statement: Faculty and TAs may grade submissions for the applicable course. Each grading action attributed to the person who performed it.

rules.name: Draft grade visibility
rules.statement: Grades/feedback remain Draft and invisible to Students until released.

rules.name: Grade release authority
rules.statement: Faculty releases grades. TA grading does not by itself release grades.

rules.name: Released grade read-only to Student
rules.statement: After release, Student views own grade/feedback read-only. No student write access.

rules.name: Post-release grade-change audit
rules.statement: Whenever a released grade is changed, log who and when.

rules.name: Not tested (open policy)
rules.statement: Late-submission (ISS-LMS-001), resubmission, TA-permission config, Observer linkage, notification channel, post-release grade-change authority (ISS-LMS-006).
